svg.title: Blueprint sheet 24, the bicycle: what a bike is worth is what it lets this person do (after Amartya Sen)

g.text: is what it lets this person do and be
the places it can take her.
this is what it is worth.
no road, no ride: what is round her counts too.
WHAT YOU CAN DO AND BE
the real choices open to you.
the old saying: money isn’t everything.
a living blueprint for a world
